text:
hana: Quick sanity check on the first-run checklist UI I just dropped in Figma: compact left rail, checklist drawer, and a small quickstart banner with two actions. URL: https://figma.com/file/new-onboard | can folks scan for item density, copy clarity, and accessibility?

lee: Glanced. Checklist is useful but feels long on first view. Suggest progressive disclosure: show 2 critical steps, then 'Show 4 more' expand. Keeps cognitive load low.

owen: Agree. Also the quickstart banner currently uses 'Start' and 'Add sample' verbs. 'Start' is ambiguous. Propose: 'Create workspace' (primary) and 'Try sample (5 min)' (secondary).

sam: For the drawer, make checklist items lightweight toggles with clear completion states. Use plain language like 'Connect repo' -> 'Connect Git repo (optional)'. Avoid jargon.

hana: Good call. On the banner placement: should it be above the workspace list or within the checklist drawer? I leaned to above list for visibility.

lee: Above list is fine as long as it doesn't block keyboard nav to the checklist. Ensure banner is after the skip link in DOM order.

a11y-bot: Automated checks: banner CTA contrast passes for primary (#0b6eff) on white at 14px = 5.3:1. Secondary muted text (#7fb3ff) fails = 3.2:1. Recommendation: use #3a78d6 or increase weight. Also flagged missing aria-expanded on the checklist drawer toggle.

own: For microcopy, add small clarifying text under primary: 'Creates a starter workspace with sample content, no billing'. This will reduce signup anxiety.

sam: Also add estimated time on sample cards and make that part of the accessible name: aria-label='Try sample: Chat demo — 5 minutes'.

hana: On progressive disclosure, UX idea: auto-expand the second step if the user dismisses the banner within 24h. Otherwise keep banner visible. Thoughts?

lee: Sounds okay but be careful with persistence. Use local storage and a clear undo in settings. Also allow skipping checklist entirely with a small 'Skip setup' link.

a11y-bot: Keyboard flow check: focus order currently goes logo -> banner CTAs -> skip link -> checklist. Should be logo -> skip link -> banner CTAs -> checklist. Fix DOM order or tabindex for accessibility.

own: On performance, the checklist drawer has a skeleton load that flashes for 200ms which seems janky. Increase skeleton duration min to 350ms or use a subtle fade to avoid content jump.

sam: Tiny copy nit: checklist header currently reads 'Get your workspace ready' -> make it action-oriented: 'Finish setup' or 'Complete setup'. Users perceive 'Get your workspace ready' as ambiguous.

hana: Plan from this thread: 1) change primary label to 'Create workspace' and add subcopy about no billing, 2) secondary 'Try sample (5 min)' with aria-label and estimated time, 3) implement progressive disclosure showing 2 steps + expand, 4) fix contrast for secondary and ensure 44px touch targets, 5) add aria-expanded on drawer, 6) correct focus/tab order, 7) smooth skeleton fade. I'll update figma and open a PR.

lee: Thanks — will review PR for focus order and DOM changes.

own: I'll add the skeleton timing tweak in frontend branch.

sam: I'll run a quick copy pass and leave comments in figma.

a11y-bot: Compliance checklist added to PR template recommended: contrast, aria labels, aria-expanded, role=status for sample start, min touch target 44px, keyboard focus order validated.

hana: Great, will ping when PR is up. Thanks!
